name: Pepper Soda
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors

ingredients.item: 6 cubes of ginger that are ¼ in (0.67 cm) in width
1 tsp (5 ml) anise seed or 2 star anise pods

steps: Combine the water, prunes, ginger, cherries, zest, mint, anise, allspice, cloves, coriander, vanilla, and sugar in a saucepan.
Boil the mixture until it becomes a thick syrup.
Strain the syrup, discarding the solids, and stir in the caffeine. You should have about 5 oz (150 ml) syrup.
To make the finished soda, mix 1 volume of syrup with 5 volumes of sparkling water.
